"""Execution-plan demo for the Generator Execution Center record 24: The Generator Execution Center Field Guide Index.
A small working planner: splits a run into throttled batches and replays it."""
import hashlib
PLAN_RECORDS = 240
THROTTLE = 100
HARD_STOP = 1000000000
SEEDS = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
def batches(total, size):
    out = []
    left = total
    while left > 0:
        out.append(min(size, left)); left -= size
    return out
def run_digest(seed):
    return hashlib.sha256(("plan|%d" % seed).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("Generator Execution Center plan demo — record 24: The Generator Execution Center Field Guide Index")
print("Planned records: %d; throttle per call: %d; hard stop: %d" % (PLAN_RECORDS, THROTTLE, HARD_STOP))
bs = batches(PLAN_RECORDS, THROTTLE)
print("Batches: " + ", ".join(str(b) for b in bs) + " (total %d)" % sum(bs))
first = run_digest(SEEDS[0]); again = run_digest(SEEDS[0])
print("Seed %d run digest: %s" % (SEEDS[0], first[:16]))
print("Replay digest:      %s" % again[:16])
print("SHA-256: " + hashlib.sha256(("|".join(str(b) for b in bs)).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())
print("Deterministic: " + ("MATCH" if first == again else "MISMATCH"))
print("Test: batches sum to the planned total — " + ("pass" if sum(bs) == PLAN_RECORDS else "fail"))
print("Test: no batch passes the throttle — " + ("pass" if all(b <= THROTTLE for b in bs) else "fail"))
print("Test: planned total is below the hard stop — " + ("pass" if PLAN_RECORDS < HARD_STOP else "fail"))
print("Test: same seed replays identically — " + ("pass" if first == again else "fail"))
print("Test: different seeds differ — " + ("pass" if run_digest(1) != run_digest(2) else "fail"))
